messages:
sophia: Heads-up: Private v2 is live for GA customers starting now. This includes: per-tenant HSM keys, configurable audit-log retention, and the compliance-pack (SOC2+PCI guidance). Please see rollout doc and action items below. :tada:
luke: Nice work! Are there any breaking changes for existing Private v1 projects?
sophia: Not breaking, but v1 projects must opt in to HSM/KMS and the new audit settings. Migration path: one-click console toggle coming next week; API is available now.
anika: API example to opt a project in (use project-update API):
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/987 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"use_hsm":true, "audit_retention_days":90, "kms_key_id":"projects/987/keys/customer-hsm"}'
```
derek: Security note: HSM keys are customer-controlled and never leave the key boundary. We added explicit key-rotation docs and a verification script (see internal link).
legal-bot: Legal: please include the following mandatory DPA clause for GA customers: "Customer may configure export and retention policies; Redwood processes data per customer settings and maintains audit logs as configured." We'll attach the full text in the rollout doc.
sophia: GTM/CSM: CSM outreach template is in the doc under "GA comms". Suggested cadence: immediate email to active Private contacts + scheduled onboarding within 2 weeks for enterprise customers.
csm-bot: PS-bot: Onboarding slots available: Thu 09:00-11:00, Fri 15:00-17:00. Book with /book-private-ps <customer>.
luke: Ops note: rollout completed to EU/US regions. We saw two customers hit a TLS handshake issue on older OS images; workaround is to update OpenSSL or flip the legacy-tls flag in the tenant settings. Root cause is patched, full fix next deploy.
anika: Known issue logged in the doc with mitigation steps; tagging infra to monitor.
derek: Action items recap: 1) Legal finalize DPA text (legal-bot) 2) CSM send outreach (sophia + csm-bot) 3) Migration toggle UI (eng) ETA next week 4) Monitor TLS regressions and notify affected customers.
sophia: We'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to confirm messaging and handoffs. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: private-v2/ga-rollout -> prod completed on pool-12 at 1782221400 :white_check_mark:
sophia: If anything blocks your item, reply here and I'll escalate. :handshake:
